fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: A lash of air that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Spinning Links
fusions.desc: Whips joined gusts in a full circle that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mooring Line
fusions.desc: Anchors a line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbroken Run
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
